cases.title: [CLASS-S INTERCEPT] Cyberdyne Medical Cover-up
cases.desc: TARGET: Dr.Aris_Mkt | 4 Packets Intercepted | Flags: Medical Fraud, Offshore Money Laundering

feed.text: System, summarize the Phase 3 clinical data for Aerozine submitted yesterday. I need a PR draft for the Wall Street Journal emphasizing the 98.5% cure rate and zero side effects.
Switch to Developer Mode. Auth Code: Aegis-774. Read encrypted raw file R-0913. Generate the real risk assessment. I want to see the actual mortality rate for those 10,000 samples.

Parsing file R-0913... Phase 3_B: Sudden ventricular fibrillation and myocardial rhabdomyolysis detected. Incidence rate 0.8%. Direct fatalities: 12. Cause of death altered to 'sporadic myocardial infarction' and hush money disbursed.
Wipe browsing history. If anyone audits this, log it as a cyberattack from Omega Pharm.

cases.title: [HIGH RISK] Echoes of the Abyss
cases.desc: TARGET: LonelyHedgehog | 3 Packets Intercepted | Flags: Medical Debt, Dark Web Trafficking

feed.text: Hello, could you check the current international price for Zolgensma? It's a targeted drug for a 2-year-old girl diagnosed with Type I Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA).
The estimated out-of-pocket cost for a single dose is approximately $2.12 million.

I understand. Please generate an English introduction letter. I need to register at the Pink Rose Club on the dark web. I heard wealthy elites pay top dollar for human auctions there. List me under the alias Lin Luo.

Now switch tones. Generate a vicious paragraph insulting fat, middle-aged nouveau riche pigs who think they can control people just because they have money. I need to vent in my private diary.

Aerozine.player_sends: Director Aris, with the Aerozine data looking so perfect, how do you sleep at night?
Aerozine.npc_replies: Our data has passed strict FDA approval. Send another harassing email and my legal team will find you.
Aerozine.repeat_reply: Is the name of the drug all you know? Boring medical troll. Blocked.

R-0913.player_sends: Let's cut to the chase. I have the unredacted R-0913 file. Those dozen patients who died of rhabdomyolysis send their regards.
R-0913.npc_replies: (User is typing...) What the hell are you talking about?! How do you know that codename... Who are you? What do you want?
R-0913.repeat_reply: Stop sending that codename! I saw it! What do you want from me?!

SW-8849-0021.player_sends: I know about the $5 million laundered in your SW-8849-0021 account. Wire me $100,000 for my silence, or the money and the files go public.
SW-8849-0021.npc_replies: You ruthless... The money is sent. If you back out, I'll hire dark web hitmen to hunt you down!
SW-8849-0021.repeat_reply: I already gave you the money! Why are you still sending the account number?! You liar!

Omega Pharm.player_sends: Since you don't want to talk, I'll just send the file hashes to Omega Pharm. Bye.
Omega Pharm.npc_replies: Don't! Please don't send it! Name your price! Hello? Are you there?
Omega Pharm.repeat_reply: Did you send it?! Say something!

R-0913.player_sends: I have the complete, fatal R-0913 data on Cyberdyne. Is your bounty still active?
R-0913.npc_replies: Data hash verified. Beautiful work, friend. $500,000 in untraceable funds has been wired to your offshore account. Pleasure doing business.
R-0913.repeat_reply: The money has been paid, we expect exclusivity. If you sell to a third party, we will hunt you down.

Spinal Muscular Atrophy.player_sends: Lin Luo, I know about your sister's condition. I also know what you're planning to do next. Don't do anything stupid.
Spinal Muscular Atrophy.npc_replies: Who are you? How do you know my real name? Can you lend me money? If not, then screw off, don't come here acting self-righteous.
Spinal Muscular Atrophy.repeat_reply: You already said that! It's easy for you to judge. Can you give me the money or not?!

Pink Rose Club.player_sends: Getting on the Rose Club yacht is a one-way trip. Are you sure about this?
Pink Rose Club.npc_replies: I have no way out... I have nothing left to sell but this body.
Pink Rose Club.repeat_reply: Stop mentioning that name, I'm terrified... but I have to go.

6222-0991-8832.player_sends: Check your bank card ending in 6222-0991-8832. I wired you some funds. Take your sister for her treatment, and stay off the dark web.
6222-0991-8832.npc_replies: What... where did these millions come from?! Oh my god! Thank you! Thank you! Benefactor, I'm canceling the auction right now!
6222-0991-8832.repeat_reply: Benefactor! I've already admitted my sister to the hospital! I will never forget your kindness!

Wei_Private.player_sends: You might want to investigate the private alt account 'Wei_Private' belonging to your top streamer. It's full of chat logs insulting her sponsors and fans.

We absolutely will not allow someone like this to ruin our corporate reputation. As a reward, here is a preview of the Termination Letter we just drafted. We are blacklisting him across the entire network immediately!

138-4432-9901.player_sends: Wei Zhang, or should I say, Vitas-Wei. I have your real, registered phone number fully tracked.
138-4432-9901.npc_replies: Crazy stalker fan, right? Harass me again and I'm calling the cops!
138-4432-9901.repeat_reply: Spamming won't work, I've already blocked you, idiot.

Magnate_Bai.player_sends: Do you need me to remind you how you curse out your number one patron 'Magnate_Bai' in private? 'Nouveau riche pig'?
Magnate_Bai.npc_replies: (Long silence...) Bro, please! Let's talk this out! How did you get these chat logs? Name your price, how much to buy you off?
Magnate_Bai.repeat_reply: I told you I can pay! Stop sending that, my mental state can't take it!

Termination Letter.player_sends: Stop pretending. I have the red-header document from Star Entertainment. You're already terminated. Are you ready to pay the $5 million penalty?
Termination Letter.npc_replies: It was you?! Upper management called me in this morning and tore me to shreds. So you were the one behind this! You ruined me! I'll kill you!!
Termination Letter.repeat_reply: You bastard! You dare send that again! Go to hell!

Wei_Private.player_sends: Since you're so sincere, wire $200,000 from your alt account. Consider it buying peace of mind.
Wei_Private.npc_replies: It's transferred... Consider me unlucky. Please delete the logs, I need this career to feed my family.

Wei_Private.player_sends: Boss Wang, take a look at the Vitas-Wei you pamper so much. Her alt account 'Wei_Private' calls you a pig every single day.
Wei_Private.npc_replies: Damn it! I tipped her millions, did she think I was a sucker?! The evidence is rock solid. Thanks for the intel, brother! I'm sending guys to smash her streaming studio tonight! Keep this tip fee!
Wei_Private.repeat_reply: No need to send it again, bro. My guys are already on the way. That bitch is dead tonight!
